preferredSource.name: NOAA Open Data - JMA Himawari-8
preferredSource.nativeFormat: HSD normalized geostationary, single S0101 unsegmented B13 file per nominal time
preferredSource.permission: NOAA is authorized to distribute JMA data freely and openly; attribution requested; transformed products must not be called unaltered originals

ciraReference.visualInspection: Watermark HIMAWARI-8 band 13, 16 SEP 18259 120000; labelled graticules at 100/110/120 E and 20/30 N. UTC not explicitly spelled out in this image.
ciraReference.projection: 4 km Mercator according to product documentation; moving 5-degree rounded center based on recent location/motion. Full exact per-frame extent not machine-readable in GIF.
ciraReference.reuse: Rehosting permission not independently established; retain research sample, prefer original external loop for users. Do not texture globe with labelled GIF.

gibsAlternative.status: 2018 Himawari subdaily coverage not verified; do not substitute daily VIIRS mosaics.

visualValidation.comparison: 12:00 regional grey-scale frame visually matches the archived CIRA 12:00 B13 spiral and band structure after accounting for different projection, extent and color enhancement. This is a visual consistency check, not a measured geolocation-accuracy claim.
